name: Milchis Catalin-Marian
headline: Working across cybersecurity and telecom
bio: I'm a Penetration Tester and fourth-year Telecommunications student at Transilvania University of Brașov. I work on web and API security at Arvato Systems Romania and telecom R&D at Mitel Networks Romania, combining offensive security with hands-on systems engineering.
